## What & why

Briefly: what does this change, and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (`node --test`)
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (zero-dependency rule)
- [ ] Any trim is a **move, not a delete** (if touching `fix`/changeset behavior)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`) and any affected docs (README / SKILL / lever references)

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know — trade-offs, follow-ups, screenshots of CLI output, etc.
